evidence: The ﬁlms were investigated for their crystal structure and thickness with the PANalytical X’Pert Pro X-ray diffractometer (Cu K a radiation) using the grazing incidence X-ray diffraction (GIXRD) and X-ray reﬂection (XRR) techniques, respectively. Optical reﬂectivity measurements were carried out for the ﬁlms at room temperature using a Jasco IRT-5000 Irtron Infrared Microscope. Seebeck coefﬁcient (S) and resistivity (q) measurements were performed at room temperature using a home-made system. Resistivity measurements were done by a simple four-point probe technique, where gold wires were attached on the surface of the ﬁlms using silver paste.
